tls.description: Connect over TLS. Implied by tlsCa and tlsCert.

tlsCa.description: PEM certificates to trust, instead of the system's.

tlsCert.description: A PEM client certificate, for mutual TLS.

tlsServerName.description: The name to verify the brokers' certificates against, if not their host.

schemaRegistryUrl.description: A Confluent-compatible schema registry. Avro and Protobuf need one.

format.description: How values and keys are encoded. Avro and Protobuf use the schema registry's wire format; string reads each value as text.

topics.description: The topics to offer as streams. Empty: every topic the credentials can describe, but internal ones.

topicPattern.description: A regular expression topics must match to be offered.

startOffset.description: Where a partition's first read starts.

group.description: The consumer group the read's offsets are committed to once checkpointed, for Kafka's tools. Default: openetl-<pipeline>.
